name: my-stelstone-site
description: Astro site + the Stelstone admin, deployed as one Cloudflare Worker.

ADMIN_PASS.description: The password for the admin panel at `/admin/` (user: `admin`). **Choose your own** — with the GitHub token it can write to your repository. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 24`.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: A [fine-grained token](https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens) with **Contents: Read and write** on this site's repository — how the admin saves content and uploads images.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: *Optional.* A [Resend](https://resend.com) API key for contact-form email.
